rationale: The public orchestrator maps every unrecognized backend string to MOONSHOT_REMOTE and immediately sends the original user prompt through the selected client for decomposition. With a configured remote credential, a typo in a local selector can thus disclose the prompt to the remote provider. This is conditional on calling this API with an invalid selector; no configured key was read and no request was sent.

source_checks.observation: Unknown backend defaults to Moonshot before client construction and task decomposition.
Moonshot selection chooses remote URL, key and model.
Client sends messages and optional Bearer credential.
The original prompt is included in the first call.

rationale: Both remote endpoint factories validate hostname only; an http:// URL for an allowed public provider host is accepted unchanged. The HTTP client receives that URL with messages and a Bearer header when a key is configured. This establishes a missing TLS requirement in the configured path, not observed disclosure; no network request or credential read was performed.

source_checks.observation: Factories return allowed-host URLs without requiring https.
The accepted URL is directly passed to AsyncClient.post.
Headers include the selected API key and payload includes messages.
